body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> Haier displayed its new 22-inch LCD HDTV series during CES 2009, which is perfect for any bedroom, office or kitchen and is available in either white or black to match your décor.

The durable, glossy frame is more compact for space-saving style that fits comfortably into smaller areas. With a 1366 x 768 high-resolution picture, the image will be clear and concise from any angle.
With the HDMI, PC and Composite inputs, you can hook up your set to cable box, video games, Blu-ray or DVD players, video cameras, computers and more, to get the best entertainment possible.
